svg.aria-label: VLANs. 10 Management: 192.168.10.0/24, gateway .254, static, for switches, the access points, the Proxmox host and the admin workstation. 20 Internal: 192.168.20.0/24, gateway .254, DHCP from SWAGGER-DC-01 relayed by the core, for trusted users, Internal Wi-Fi and WKS-01. 30 Guest: 192.168.30.0/24, gateway .254 on OPNsense, DHCP from OPNsense, visitor Wi-Fi with internet only. 40 Servers: 192.168.40.0/24, gateway .254, static, for virtual machines and the UNAS Pro. 50 Cameras: 172.16.0.0/27, gateway 172.16.0.30 on the core, DHCP from OPNsense relayed by the core, for four PoE cameras and the NVR. Native VLAN 999: no subnet and no hosts, native on every trunk except the access point ports.
svg.title: VLANs
